calibration: Single unchanged W4A16 FP16-KV reference path per document. Use all causal positions and heads. At each layer compute mean squared attention-output errors for (4,2), (8,2), (4,4) on identical Q/K/V. Average document MSE with equal weights. Use Structured K8 and Lloyd-Max K4/V2/V4 with the current codec policy.
gain: g_K = E(4,2) - E(8,2); g_V = E(4,2) - E(4,4). Sort independently by descending gain, breaking ties by lower layer number.
budgets: Enumerate k = 0..14. Assign K8 to the k highest K gains, V4 to the 28-2k highest V gains. Choose the greatest sum of selected gains; smaller k wins an exact tie.
candidates: Evaluate predicted k, its feasible immediate neighbors, and the historical K5/V3 Early anchor. Deduplicate by exact deployment config hash.
selection: Minimize total NLL divided by all validation targets. Exact ties favor Early, then lexical plan ID. Freeze before scoring test.
test: Evaluate only the validation winner and Early once each on the independent test. If the winner equals Early, reuse that one measurement.
uncertainty: Paired document bootstrap for test NLL (10000 resamples, seed 20261123); descriptive only.
timing: Record calibration capture and three local states including setup and IO; rank and validation; report evaluation and test separately. No 64-mask reference search.
